name: Apricot kernel oil
description: Apricot kernel oil (CAS 72869-69-3 ), also referenced under FEMA 2105 , is a light carrier oil cold-pressed from the seeds of Prunus armeniaca. It is used across personal care, food, and pharmaceutical manufacturing as a skin-conditioning agent and flavoring carrier. In cosmetics and personal care, it functions as a lightweight emollient base in facial creams, serums, massage oils, and lip products. It is valued for its skin absorption profile that supports high-end formulation aesthetics. Food manufacturers use it as a flavoring ingredient and specialty culinary oil, particularly in confectionery and gourmet applications. It is ideal where a mild, nutty character is required for the final product profile. Pharmaceutical and nutraceutical formulators incorporate it as a carrier oil in softgel capsules, topical preparations, and oral delivery systems. It also appears in premium hair care formulations as a conditioning agent. The oil acts as a conditioning agent in leave-in treatments and scalp oils. Apricot kernel oil is supplied as a clear to pale yellow liquid, typically in bulk drums, IBCs, and smaller packaging for specialty formulators. Cosmetic-grade and food-grade specifications are the most common commercial offerings. Cosmetic grades often meet ISO 16128 natural origin criteria, ensuring high quality for international distribution and manufacturing standards. Cold-pressed and refined variants are both available, with cold-pressed grades commanding preference in natural and organic product lines.
